learning_outcomes.text: Learns and applies the methods used for the determination of thermal comfort.
Learns and applies the methods used for the determination of thermal insulation of buildings.
Understands heating systems. Knows and applies the methods used for the determination of system characteristics
Understands of cooling systems. Knows and applies the methods used for the determination of system characteristics
Understands of ventilating systems. Knows and applies the methods used for the determination of system characteristics
Understands of air-conditioning systems. Knows and applies the methods used for the determination of system characteristics
